scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix simulator ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.db:studio: npm run db:up && npm --prefix api run prisma:studio
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d db api simulator web
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose up -d --build db api simulator web
scripts.docker:test: docker compose up -d db && docker compose run --rm test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,simulator,web "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix simulator run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
